fields.schemeName: Incentive for the Inter Caste Marriage Couple
fields.briefDescription: The Social Welfare Department of the Government of Karnataka has launched the "Incentive for the Inter Caste Marriage Couple", which offers incentives to couples belonging to the SC community and Non-SC. The scheme aims to promote inter-caste marriages and provide financial assistance to the couples

fields.schemeName: Pipes Carrying Water From Source To Field
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides subsidies to farmers for installing pipes to carry water from the source to their fields, offering a 50% subsidy or up to ₹15,000/- for pipes (up to 800m), including PVC, HDPE, and others.

fields.schemeName: Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme" is an initiative by the Karnataka Minority Development Corporation (KMDC) to promote self-employment and economic activities among minority communities. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible individuals from minority communities.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide social security to the disabled women/men of the state by encouraging their marriage and providing them financial assistance. This scheme is fully funded by the Government of Bihar.

fields.schemeName: Farmers Training
fields.briefDescription: The “Farmers Training” scheme provides financial assistance for training sessions involving up to 50 farmers or agricultural laborers per cluster.

fields.schemeName: Skill Upgradation Program Karnataka
fields.briefDescription: The "Skill Upgradation Program Karnataka" scheme aims to upgrade the skills of artisans in leather technology, footwear/leather goods making, and designing by sending them for advanced training at renowned institutions like CFTI Chennai, CLRI, and Karnataka Institute of Leather Technology.

fields.schemeName: Providing Artificial Limbs and Other Appliances to Disabled BOC Workers
fields.briefDescription: The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board has launched a scheme to provide artificial limbs & other appliances to registered disabled construction workers. The scheme also covers the replacement of limbs every three years based on the workers' needs.

fields.schemeName: 15 Days Skill Up-gradation Training
fields.briefDescription: The "15 Days Skill Up-gradation Training" scheme aims to provide skill training, safety, and hygiene education for building and other construction workers registered with the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

fields.schemeName: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Scholarship-Free Education upto 12th Std. to All
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free education for Adi Dravidar, Tribal and Adi Dravidar (Converted to Christianity) students up to 12th standard, covering tuition fees, which are reimbursed by the government.

fields.schemeName: Admission of Adi Dravidar/Tribal Students in Plus One at Reputed Schools
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides education benefits by admitting top Adi Dravidar/Tribal Students into reputed private schools for Plus One, covering 320 students annually across districts.

fields.schemeName: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Stationary-Text Books
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free textbooks to students from 1st to 12th standard in Adi Dravidar and Tribal welfare schools.

fields.schemeName: Pre Examination Training Centre For All India Service Examinations Like I.A.S., I.P.S., I.R.S., Etc.
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free pre-examination training, boarding, and lodging for Adi Dravidar and Tribal community candidates preparing for All India Service Examinations like IAS, IPS, and IRS.

fields.schemeName: Seed Multiplication Scheme of Paddy, Millets, Pulses, Oilseeds and Cotton
fields.briefDescription: The “Seed Multiplication Scheme of Paddy, Millets, Pulses, Oilseeds, and Cotton” offers subsidies to farmers to produce seeds under contract with the Department of Agriculture.

fields.schemeName: Production of Foundation Seeds
fields.briefDescription: The "Production of Foundation Seeds" scheme, provides subsidies to farmers cultivating seed farms for pulses, offering specific benefits to SC/ST farmers and farm women.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers" is a Welfare Scheme by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers LET&F (Labour) Dept. The scheme provides financial assistance to help mitigate the financial burden on the worker's family.

fields.schemeName: Pipes Carrying Water From Source To Field-Pulses ISPOM
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides subsidies to farmers for installing pipes to carry water from the source to their fields, offering a 50% subsidy or up to ₹15,000/- for pipes (up to 800m), including PVC, HDPE, and others.

fields.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme- Bihar
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹400/- is provided to widows in the age group of 40 to 79 years who belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to support them financially. This scheme is centrally sponsored.

fields.schemeName: Medical Assistance for the Treatment of Critical Illness
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, medical assistance of ₹1,00,000/- for the treatment of serious ailments for registered worker and his/her family members. (the benefit can be availed only after 26th July 2014 as the benefit is covered under the Mediclaim & Personal Accident Insurance scheme).

fields.schemeName: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Working Women
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to working women through loans up to ₹20,000/- at a 12% interest rate via District Central Cooperative Banks and their branches.

fields.schemeName: Free Education Scholarship for Three-Year Diploma (Polytechnic Courses)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free education scholarships for students from Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities pursuing 3-year Diploma courses in Government and Government-Aided Polytechnics.

fields.schemeName: Free Education Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial support to Backward, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities students pursuing 3-year undergraduate courses (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com.) in Government and Government Aided Arts and Science Colleges.

fields.schemeName: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Professional Loan to Doctors, Engineers and Self Employed Professional
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides professional loans to doctors, engineers, and self-employed professionals through District Central Cooperative Banks. The maximum loan amount is ₹10,00,000 at an interest rate of 13% (subject to change).

fields.schemeName: Maternity Benefit for Women Beneficiaries
fields.briefDescription: The "Maternity Benefit for Women Beneficiaries" scheme under the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial assistance to pregnant women registered as beneficiaries and wives of registered beneficiaries. The assistance can be availed up to two times.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Natural Death
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Natural Death” was launched by the Maharashtra Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW), Labour Department Maharashtra. Under the scheme, the Board provides financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- to the legal heir of a registered worker who dies.

fields.schemeName: Skill Development Training Manipur
fields.briefDescription: The Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board offers "Skill Development Training" to registered building workers, their spouse, dependent siblings, and children. The training includes vocational and skill development courses from recognized government and private providers.

fields.schemeName: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Revamped Micro Credit Loan for Women Vendors of Flower, Vegetable, Fruit etc.
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides revamped micro credit loans through District Central Cooperative Banks to support women vendors selling flowers, vegetables, fruits etc. Loans range from  ₹100/- to  ₹5,000/- with an interest rate of 11%.

fields.schemeName: Rural Girls’ Incentive Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme provides financial support to girls students of Most Backward Classes (MBC) and Denotified Communities (DNC) studying in rural government or government-aided schools, aimed at encouraging education and reducing school dropouts.

fields.schemeName: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Handloom and Other Non Farm Sector Activities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers loans for handloom and other non-farm sector activities, with a maximum loan amount of up to ₹2,00,000/- at an interest rate of 11% to 12.5%. The scheme is designed to support farmers engaged in non-farm activities.

fields.schemeName: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Animal Husbandry
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides loans to farmers for the purpose of animal husbandry, allowing them to improve their income through livestock.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance to the Children of the Registered Worker Studying in 11th and 12th Standard
fields.briefDescription: The "Educational Assistance" scheme provides financial support of ₹10,000 per year to children of registered construction workers who are studying in the 11th or 12th standard. The benefit applies to a maximum of two children per worker and extends to the wife of a registered male worker.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance for Degree Course
fields.briefDescription: The Educational Assistance for Degree Course scheme provides financial assistance to children of registered construction workers pursuing their undergraduate degree (1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th year, if applicable). This benefit is also extended to the wife of a registered male worker.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance to the 10th to 12th Students
fields.briefDescription: The Educational Assistance to the 10th to 12th Students scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW), Labour Department Maharashtra.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance for Medical and Engineering Courses
fields.briefDescription: The Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides educational assistance to the children and spouses of registered construction workers pursuing medical and engineering degrees.

fields.schemeName: Funeral Assistance Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 13th August 2013, the "Funeral Assistance Scheme" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. Madhya Pradesh provides ₹3,000/- for the last rites of destitute or unclaimed bodies.  The scheme also supports families registered under labour schemes.

fields.schemeName: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Inland Fishing
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers loans to farmers for inland fishing projects, with a loan amount of up to ₹3,30,000/- per hectare at an interest rate between 11% and 12%.

fields.schemeName: Goat Unit Scheme On Grants And Bank Loans
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial support through grants and bank loans to farmers to purchase (10+1) goat units for milk and meat production. The scheme covers a 40% subsidy for general applicants and 60% for SC/ST beneficiaries, based on a total unit cost of ₹77,456/-.

fields.schemeName: State Senior Citizens Home
fields.briefDescription: The Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Mizoram launched the State Senior Citizens Home for the homeless aged persons. It provides shelter and facilities to homeless elderly individuals aged 60 and above, who lack family support.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Gram Parivahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme provides financial assistance for purchasing vehicles to enhance transportation facilities in rural areas. It includes grants for regular vehicles, e-rickshaws, and ambulances under specified conditions.

fields.schemeName: Incentive For The Devadasi Children’s Marriage to Schedule Tribe
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Incentive for the Devadasi Children’s Marriage to Schedule Tribe" by the Govt of Karnataka provides incentives for the marriage of Devadasi's ST children. Couples married on or after 01-04-2019 are given an incentive of ₹8 Lakh, i.e. ₹3 Lakh for groom and ₹5 Lakh for bride.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship for Class 11th 12th And College
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Post-Matric Scholarship" started in 1945 by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Madhya Pradesh, provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students studying in classes 11th, 12th, Colleges, PhD, and Professional Courses.

fields.schemeName: Integrated Hostel Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Integrated Hostel Scheme" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free residential facilities, meals, and basic amenities to SC/ST/OBC students studying in classes 1st to 12th and also to the students pursuing college education.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanya Suraksha Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Kanya Suraksha Yojana (MKSY)" is a welfare initiative by the Government of Bihar to combat female foeticide, improve the sex ratio, and promote birth registration.

fields.schemeName: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases
fields.briefDescription: “Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases” under the “Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana” by the Labour Resources Dept., provides financial assistance ranging from ₹7,500/- to ₹30,000/- to workers or craftsmen suffering from incurable diseases.

fields.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Family Pension
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, beneficiaries, upon retirement or unfortunate demise, will have 50% of their last drawn amount transferred monthly to their families through a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.

fields.schemeName: Mushroom Kit Vitaran
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide subsidized mushroom kits and training to farmers, promoting mushroom cultivation as a sustainable livelihood opportunity.

fields.schemeName: Paternity Benefit (HPBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The "Paternity Benefit" scheme by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides ₹6,000/- per delivery to the wife of a registered worker (for up to two deliveries) and ₹1,000/- to the male worker upon the birth of a child.

fields.schemeName: Death Assistance Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 2004, the scheme "Death Assistance Scheme" is a welfare scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB), Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides funeral assistance and ex-gratia payment to the heir of a worker in the event of their death.

fields.schemeName: Term Loan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to uplift the economically disadvantaged Charmakar community (Dhor, Chambhar, Holar, Mochi, etc.) by promoting their educational, economic, and social development, helping them gain a respectable place in society.

fields.schemeName: Primary Education Scholarship (Madhya Pradesh)
fields.briefDescription: The "Primary Education Scholarship" scheme provides ₹150/- annually to students from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities who are studying in classes 1st to 5th.  The scholarship distribution is managed through the Directorate of Public Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh.

fields.schemeName: Operation of SC Senior Hostel
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Operation of SC Senior Hostel" provides accommodations and a conducive learning environment for Scheduled Caste students. Through this scheme, separate junior, senior, and college hostels with free boarding and lodging facilities are provided to both boys and girls.
